title: Google Play Is Expanding Age Confirmation Tools For App Developers
excerpt: The Age Signals API will be available globally before the end of the year.
content_html:
The Age Signals API will be available globally before the end of the year.

Jetcityimage/Getty Images

Google shared some details on how it will ask Android developers to handle age verification requirements. The platform it's adopting is called the Google Play Age Signals API. The tool is currently being tested in Brazil, and it will arrive in Australia and Canada in mid-August ahead of a global rollout later in the year.

The Age Signals tool allows parents to share their own or their child's age with devs as a range. This as a more private option than requiring age be shared as a specific number or birthdate while still helping devs meet a growing number of age verification requirements. If an adult shares their child's age range, all apps using the API will have access to the information and the program will automatically deliver an age-appropriate experience. The parent controls will be available in the Google Family Link app.

"Rather than enforcing one-size-fits-all rules, we give developers the flexibility to choose how they integrate safety signals. With this reliable signal, you retain complete agency to tailor your app's content, features, and settings to match your audience," Google's blog post states. Age verification has become a hot topic over the past year, with several countries and US states passing wide-reaching laws putting more responsibility on platform owners and app developers to make checks.

Age Signals API 将于今年年底前在全球推出。

谷歌分享了一些关于如何要求 Android 开发者处理年龄验证要求的细节。 它采用的平台称为 Google Play Age Signals API。 该工具目前正在巴西进行测试，将于 8 月中旬抵达澳大利亚和加拿大，然后于今年晚些时候在全球推出。

年龄信号工具允许家长与开发人员分享自己或孩子的年龄范围。 与要求将年龄共享为特定数字或出生日期相比，这是一种更加私密的选择，同时仍然可以帮助开发人员满足越来越多的年龄验证要求。 如果成人分享孩子的年龄范围，所有使用 API 的应用程序都将有权访问该信息，并且该程序将自动提供适合年龄的体验。 家长控制将在 Google Family Link 应用中提供。

“我们不是强制执行一刀切的规则，而是让开发人员能够灵活地选择如何集成安全信号。 有了这个可靠的信号，您就可以保留完整的代理权来定制应用程序的内容、功能和设置以匹配您的受众，”谷歌的博客文章指出。 过去一年，年龄验证已成为热门话题，多个国家和美国各州通过了影响广泛的法律，赋予平台所有者和应用程序开发商更多的检查责任。
